constraints.name: AutomaticReportAutomationGrant_allowedFrequencies_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK ((("allowedFrequencies" <@ ARRAY['DAILY'::text, 'WEEKLY'::text, 'MONTHLY'::text]) AND (array_position("allowedFrequencies", NULL::text) IS NULL) AND (cardinality("allowedFrequencies") = ((
CASE
    WHEN ('DAILY'::text = ANY ("allowedFrequencies")) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END +
CASE
    WHEN ('WEEKLY'::text = ANY ("allowedFrequencies")) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) +
CASE
    WHEN ('MONTHLY'::text = ANY ("allowedFrequencies")) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END))))
